What is Majal Network Lab measuring?
Majal Network Lab gives you an estimate of your current Internet speed. You will generally be able to get this speed from leading Internet services, which use globally distributed servers.

Why does Majal Network Lab focus primarily on download speed?
Download speed is most relevant for people who are consuming content on the Internet, and we want Majal Network Lab to be a very simple and fast speed test.

What about ping, latency, upload and other things?
When you click the “Show more info” button, you can see your upload speed and connection latency (ping). Majal Network Lab provides two different latency measurements for your Internet connection: “unloaded” and “loaded” with traffic. The difference between these two measurements is also called “bufferbloat”.

How are the results calculated?
To calculate your Internet speed, Majal Network Lab performs a series of downloads from and uploads to public LibreSpeed test servers and calculates the maximum speed your Internet connection can provide. More details are in our blog post.

Will the Majal Network Lab speed test work everywhere in the world?
Majal Network Lab will test Internet speed globally on any device (phone, laptop, or smart TV with browser).

Why does Majal Network Lab offer this test?
We want our members to have a simple, quick, ad-free way to estimate the Internet speed that their ISP is providing.

What can I do if I'm not getting the speed I pay for?
If results from Majal Network Lab and other Internet speed tests often show less speed than you have paid for, you can ask your ISP about the results.

Can Majal Network Lab be used to certify enterprise bandwidth or other service certification?
Majal Network Lab is designed for general usage by individual Internet users. It is not designed or supported for 3rd party service certification or other enterprise usage.
